newsitem.title: UK: St Paul to purchase reinsurance business - journal.
newsitem.headline: St Paul to purchase reinsurance business - journal.

text.p: St. Paul Re, the New York-based reinsurance operation of the St. Paul Companies, is set to expand following an agreement to purchase the right to renew Constitution Reinsurance Corporation's book of U.S. casualty facultative reinsurance, according to a U.S. insurance journal.

National Underwriter reports that St. Paul Re's parent company has acquired the right for St. Paul Re to renew a portfolio of business currently underwritten by Constitution Re in New York (the company's headquarters), Atlanta, Chicago, Los Angeles and Philadelphia.
"This transaction represents the latest in our continuing efforts to diversify our business by product and geographically," it quates St. Paul Re President Jim Duffy.
